class.comment: Read classDiagram-v2 or classDiagram at a word boundary, then retain the class diagram context. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and class.md#detection.

class-direction.comment: Read a direction line by testing TB, BT, RL and LR and selecting the last occurrence for the selected value. Other text on the line retains its direction-text scope. Directives cannot supply a direction token, and separator-led comments stop text and padding. Follows class.md#the-statement-context and common.md#comment-lines.

class-comment.comment: Read a native percent comment through physical line end, retaining directives within its mark and body. A separator-led common comment starts a separate region. Follows class.md#the-statement-context and common.md#comment-lines.
class-comment.name: comment.line.percentage.mermaid

class-declaration.comment: Read a bounded class keyword and its declaration context through line end. That context admits names, strings, a member body and shared units; a closing brace may instead finish the enclosing namespace. Follows class.md#the-statement-context and class.md#the-class-context.

class-namespace.comment: Read namespace and its name, followed by a braced body of class declarations, notes and nested namespaces. The header and body each include their permitted shared units. Follows class.md#the-namespace-context and class.md#namespaces.

class-members.comment: Read the braces of a member body and its member lines through the closing brace. Follows class.md#the-member-context.

patterns.comment: Bound a body member at a brace or physical line end, then apply the shared member division. Follows class.md#the-member-context.

class-style.comment: Read style targets or classDef names and display their comma-separated property pairs for the reader. The document's style units may include several displayed properties. Follows class.md#other-statements.

patterns.comment: Read a style property name before its colon. Follows class.md#other-statements.

Color each comma-delimited property value separately, although the document can keep multiple properties in one style unit. Retain interior spaces, colons and description-looking text, leaving trailing whitespace and the final semicolon outside the value scope. Parenthesized values retain their internal separators and spacing. Follows class.md#other-statements and ast/class.md#classstylestatement.

Read a style before its first colon or without a colon, ending at a comma or a following description block as well as the line boundary. Display a final semicolon separately. Follows class.md#other-statements and ast/class.md#classstylestatement.

class-shared.comment: Class, namespace and statement contexts share the listed strings, keywords, names, labels, generics, relation ends and punctuation. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules.

patterns.comment: The keyword note for has exactly one space between its words; directives next to that space lie between the note and for units. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules.
Read the bounded statement keywords and href. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules.
patterns.name: keyword.control.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read one of the four fixed link targets. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules.
patterns.name: constant.language.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a class annotation's angle-pair delimiters and free name, keeping directives separate. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules and class.md#members-and-annotations.
Read a relation tail with labels and accessibility description blocks. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules and class.md#the-statement-context.
Read a triple colon introducing a class suffix. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.class.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read square brackets around a class label. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules.
Read spacing between parts of a name without assigning it a unit scope. Follows class.md#units-and-contexts.

Words, hyphens and Unicode letters are name parts, optionally separated by a dot; digit runs are words, not numeric units. Name parts are consumed whole so keyword suffixes are not recolored. Follows class.md#class-names.
A double quote starts a string ending at the next double quote, with no escape mechanism. Follows class.md#strings-backquoted-names-and-generic-types.

class-backquote.comment: A backquote starts a unit whose text runs to the next matching delimiter, with no escape mechanism. Follows class.md#strings-backquoted-names-and-generic-types.

patterns.comment: Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows class.md#strings-backquoted-names-and-generic-types.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

class-generic.comment: ~ enters the generic context; another ~ leaves it, and other characters form generic-text. Follows class.md#strings-backquoted-names-and-generic-types.

patterns.comment: Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows class.md#strings-backquoted-names-and-generic-types.
patterns.name: entity.name.type.mermaid

class-label.comment: Read a relation label after its colon, allowing percent pairs and keyword spellings as text. Another colon, semicolon or physical line end stops the run. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules.

patterns.comment: Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows class.md#the-shared-rules.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

class-call.comment: Read a callback name and its argument text in successive contexts, retaining the name's physical lines. Follows class.md#the-callback-contexts.

patterns.comment: Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows class.md#the-callback-contexts.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

class-acc-descr-block.comment: Read an accDescr keyword and brace-delimited accessibility description, retaining directives in its padding. Follows class.md#the-statement-context and class.md#accessibility-values.

patterns.comment: Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows class.md#accessibility-values and common.md#comment-lines.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

class-accessibility-line.comment: Read a colon-led accTitle or accDescr value with its surrounding padding. The value extends through physical line end unless a common-comment boundary intervenes. Follows class.md#the-statement-context and class.md#accessibility-values.

class-comma.comment: Commas separate classDef names and styles. Follows class.md#the-statement-context.
class-comma.name: keyword.operator.separator.comma.mermaid

class-namespace-body.comment: Only the body enables class declarations; namespace names use the namespace context and shared rules. Follows class.md#the-namespace-body-context.

class-method-segment.comment: Read the first divisible segment of a method member, splitting at the final noninitial opening parenthesis before its last closer. Earlier parentheses stay in its name or parameters. The enclosing member classifier excludes attributes; this alternative precedes standalone directives so the leading padding capture can retain them. Follows class.md#member-lines.

patterns.comment: Read a classifier immediately after the method's closing parenthesis, followed by its return type. A classifier-like character at the end remains type text, and directives in padding retain their scopes. Follows class.md#member-lines and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

Read a method return type with an optional trailing classifier when no classifier immediately follows the closing parenthesis. Directives in padding retain their scopes. Follows class.md#member-lines and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Retain the unread suffix of a method line as ignored text. Follows class.md#member-lines.

class-direction-text.comment: Read the nonblank ignored text around a direction while retaining directives. Follows class.md#the-statement-context.

patterns.name: comment.block.ignored.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a nonblank direction-text unit. Follows class.md#the-statement-context.

class-callback-name.comment: Enter the callback name at call, retain its text across physical lines, and return at the opening parenthesis. Follows class.md#the-callback-contexts.

patterns.name: entity.name.function.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read callback-name text through physical lines, leaving its opening parenthesis and common comment boundary for their rules. Follows class.md#the-callback-contexts.

class-member-line.comment: Divide member text identically in a member statement and a class body, after its enclosing rule has bounded the text. Follows class.md#member-lines.

patterns.comment: Read a member annotation's free name and delimiters, retaining directives in its name and surrounding whitespace. Follows class.md#member-lines and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

Only a member whose first non-whitespace character is not ) and that contains ) is a method line. Classify the whole member before looking for its first divisible segment; an attribute stays an attribute across line and paragraph separators. Follows class.md#member-lines.
Retain text before the first divisible method segment. Follows class.md#member-lines.
Read an attribute's visibility, name, and classifier without interpreting keyword-looking member text as statements. Follows class.md#member-lines.
Read an attribute's visibility, name and classifier, retaining directives in trailing whitespace. Follows class.md#member-lines and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Keep an attribute name outside the displayed type-and-name forms whole, retaining its directives. Follows class.md#member-lines.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

class-member-parts.comment: Display Type name, name : Type and a lone name for the reader inside an attribute's member-name or one method parameter. Keep generic types with one nested tilde pair and array types whole. These display parts leave the document's units unchanged. End anchors require a complete form; the enclosing whole-text fallback wins over a later suffix match, including in text with directives. Bodies and member statements use these same capture-local forms. Follows class.md#member-lines, class.md#the-member-context, and class.md#members-and-annotations.

patterns.comment: Display a complete type-and-name pair, including generic and array type text. Follows class.md#member-lines.
Display a complete name-colon-type pair with its colon scoped separately. Follows class.md#member-lines.
Display a lone member or parameter name without inventing a type. Follows class.md#member-lines.

class-method-parameters.comment: Display the parameters unit as comma-separated parameters for the reader, preserving commas within paired tildes. A directive anywhere in the unit keeps its former text scope and directive scopes. Follows class.md#member-lines and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

patterns.comment: Keep a parameters unit containing a directive in its original text scope. Follows class.md#member-lines and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a complete displayed parameter, retaining paired-tilde text before considering a comma boundary. Follows class.md#member-lines.
Keep an unrecognized parameter in its original text scope. Follows class.md#member-lines.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

patterns.comment: Display a parameter separator outside generic text. Follows class.md#member-lines.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.comma.mermaid

class-member-label.comment: Read a member statement's colon and divide its text with the same rules as a body member. Relation tails retain the label rule in their own context. Follows class.md#members-and-annotations.

comment: The local padding variables retain the whitespace required by this type's unit rules, stopping before separator-led comments. Text and context variables below name the corresponding rules of this diagram. The member-word part stops at whitespace, colons, commas, tildes, parentheses, square brackets, equality signs, percent marks and quotes. The member-type part adds a generic with one nested tilde pair and array suffixes for display, leaving the member units unchanged. Follows class.md#units-and-contexts and class.md#member-lines.
